steps.code:
# Now let me get the liked songs and the current queue.
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_songs)}")
liked_song_ids = {song["song_id"] for song in liked_songs}
print(liked_song_ids)

queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print(f"Queue length: {len(queue)}")
for song in queue:
    print(song["position"], song["song_id"], song["title"])

steps.code:
# I need to remove all liked songs from the queue. I'll remove them from the highest position to the lowest to avoid position shifting issues.
positions_to_remove = [song["position"] for song in queue if song["song_id"] in liked_song_ids]
positions_to_remove.sort(reverse=True)
print(f"Positions to remove: {positions_to_remove}")

for pos in positions_to_remove:
    result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(access_token=access_token, position=pos)
    print(f"Removed position {pos}: {result}")

# Verify the queue after removal
updated_queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print(f"\nUpdated queue length: {len(updated_queue)}")
for song in updated_queue:
    print(song["position"], song["song_id"], song["title"])
